title: LLM-ACES: Closed-Loop Discovery of Dynamical Systems with LLM-Guided Adaptive Search
abstract: arXiv:2606.25039v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recovering governing ordinary differential equations (ODEs) from data is a central challenge in modeling dynamical systems across scientific domains. Existing approaches cast discovery as a static inference problem over fixed datasets, assuming that the observed trajectories are sufficiently informative. However, dynamical systems evolve over large state spaces, and limited data can make multiple equations observationally indistinguishable, leading to identifiability gaps and the recovery of incorrect governing equations. To address this, we introduce LLM-ACES, or LLM-guided Active Closed-loop Equation Search, a closed-loop framework that jointly optimizes symbolic hypothesis construction and adaptive data acquisition. In LLM-ACES, a large language model (LLM) proposes operator priors that define constrained subspaces of the symbolic search space, within which candidate equations are fit to the observed data. translated_title: LLM-ACES：基于大语言模型引导自适应搜索的动力系统闭环发现
translated_abstract: 从数据中恢复控制性常微分方程（ODE）是对各科学领域动力系统建模的核心挑战。现有方法将方程发现视为固定数据集上的静态推断问题，并假设观测到的轨迹包含足够的信息。然而，动力系统在广阔的状态空间上演化，有限的数据可能使多个方程在观测上不可区分，从而导致可辨识性缺口以及错误控制方程的恢复。为解决这一问题，我们提出了LLM-ACES（大语言模型引导的主动闭环方程搜索），这是一个联合优化符号假设构建与自适应数据采集的闭环框架。在LLM-ACES中，大语言模型（LLM）提出算子先验，这些先验定义了符号搜索空间的受约束子空间，候选方程在该子空间内对观测数据进行拟合。（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: LLM-ACES提出了一种由大语言模型引导的闭环方程发现框架，通过LLM生成算子先验来缩小符号搜索空间，并联合优化假设构建与自适应数据采集，利用候选方程间的分歧指导新数据获取，从而消除可辨识性缺口、准确恢复动力系统的控制方程。
en_tdlr: LLM-ACES introduces an LLM-guided closed-loop framework that jointly optimizes symbolic hypothesis construction and adaptive data acquisition, using LLM-proposed operator priors to constrain the search space and disagreement-driven sampling to close identifiability gaps and accurately recover governing ODEs from limited data.
